title: The starter is the bakery
thesis: The slow invisible part of the work decides the result, long before anyone sees it.

nodes.text: To team leads who reward what they can see: here is a story about what you can't see yet.
The month of feeding the starter is where the bread is made; nothing done at the oven can rescue a weak one.

evidence.filled_by: transcript s1 line 5: "If the starter is weak, the loaves come out flat and sour and nobody can fix that at the oven."

nodes.text: The eleven years of notebooks are the same slow invisible work, kept up long enough to become judgement.

evidence.filled_by: transcript s2 line 9: "That was the moment she knew he would be good."

nodes.text: The brief has no detail on the notebooks: whose they are, what is in them, and how they connect to the moment in s2 line 9.
Protect the unglamorous early work on your team before it has anything to show.
What does protecting it look like in practice? The brief states the purpose but names no concrete action for the reader to take.
